methodology.title: Our Methodology | The CloudAlls Deployment Pipeline
methodology.description: A rigorous six-stage CloudAlls engineering methodology designed for scalability, security, and operational certainty.
methodology.keywords: CloudAlls methodology, enterprise architecture process, software engineering pipeline

sections.heading: 01 — Understand
sections.body: Frame the problem, users, constraints, success measures, and risks before choosing technology.

sections.heading: 02 — Architect
sections.body: Design the system boundaries, data contracts, security model, and delivery plan.

sections.heading: 03 — Build
sections.body: Implement the smallest reliable path with clean interfaces, tests, and observable behavior.

sections.heading: 04 — Validate
sections.body: Test accessibility, performance, security, data integrity, and real user workflows.

sections.heading: 05 — Operate
sections.body: Deploy with monitoring, backups, rollback procedures, and clear ownership.

sections.heading: 06 — Improve
sections.body: Use evidence from production to refine the product, platform, and operating model.

sections.heading: Agentic workflow engine
sections.body: A typed, auditable orchestration layer for autonomous enterprise workflows — invoice processing, support triage, and reporting agents with explicit human-approval gates and full decision traceability.
bullets: Typed tool registries and human-approval gates

sections.heading: Zero-trust device mesh
sections.body: Reference architecture for micro-segmented physical environments — IoT, CCTV, and access-control devices isolated from core networks with encrypted telemetry and automated lateral-movement detection.

sections.heading: Edge telemetry gateway
sections.body: An open hardware-firmware reference design bringing observability to custom IoT and machinery builds, with secure firmware updates and authenticated data channels.

sections.heading: Open source at CloudAlls
sections.body: Practical knowledge becomes more valuable when it is documented, tested, and shared. Labs releases developer tooling and reference architectures on GitHub under the CloudAlls lab organization for the wider engineering community, extending the Foundry research agenda.
